description: This pie chart illustrates a comparison between two categories, likely representing time durations given the use of seconds ("s") in the data values. The chart consists of a total of two slices. The smaller slice is colored blue, is visually emphasized by being exploded or offset from the rest of the pie, and is accompanied by the external text label "Efficient deployment." Inside this blue slice, data labels indicate a value of "26.2s (30.08%)." The larger slice is colored orange and contains the internal text "60.9s (69.92%)," though it lacks an explicit external text label, featuring only a blank grey rectangle positioned near its bottom left edge. The chart does not include a traditional legend; instead, it relies on direct labeling, with both absolute values and percentages displayed inside the respective slices. Visually, the larger orange segment constitutes the majority of the pie, while the smaller blue segment is separated to draw attention.
